purpose: Separate engineering preparation and library setup from steady-state kernel performance.

rules.compile_seconds: wall time for the exact selected module set, with cache state recorded
rules.calibration_seconds: hardware probes and candidate timing before selection
rules.search_seconds: candidate enumeration and selection timing, including seeds
rules.first_use_seconds: setup plus first correct execution, reported separately from steady state
rules.break_even_calls: preparation_seconds / (baseline_kernel_ms - cuButterfly_kernel_ms), only when denominator is positive
